info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Service Retrieval API allows users to access details about specific banking operational services based on a unique identifier, param1. This API endpoint is essential for financial and banking applications, enabling developers to retrieve vital information necessary for processing internal bank account operations. Ideal for banking analysts and financial software developers, this API supports use cases such as data integration, account management, and compliance reporting. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their banking processes and enhance service efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve details for an internal bank account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific internal bank account using its unique identifier (ACC-200045). This information is crucial for monitoring and managing financial operations within the organization.
